subject: pe

items.q: Can muscles push as well as pull?
items.correct: No — muscles can only pull (contract); they work in antagonistic pairs.
items.misconception: Yes, muscles both push and pull bones.
items.random_wrong: Muscles work alone, never in pairs.
items.why: One muscle pulls a bone one way; its partner pulls it back (e.g. biceps and triceps).

items.q: What causes muscle fatigue during hard exercise?
items.correct: A build-up of lactic acid from anaerobic respiration.
items.misconception: Lactic acid making the muscles grow.
items.random_wrong: The heart being a muscle you control consciously.
items.why: When oxygen is short, muscles respire anaerobically, producing lactic acid that causes fatigue.

specSource: OCR GCSE (9–1) PE & Sport Science (J587) specification; Applied Anatomy and Physiology
